content.description: P1 it01: structure locked; switch on early_start (p=0.13) and queue_space_seeking (seeker share 0.25, p_wrong_lane 0.5, p_sidewalk 0.2, q=20 m); everything else at the Saval base values.

driver_archetypes.rationale: Unchanged Saval et al. 2023 Table 11 car values: no feedback yet shows car headway (M1/car 0.3467 s) or car red running (M3/share/car 0.0041) is off, and cars stop at red, so nothing is moved.

Unchanged: no queue_space_seeking option exists for custom2 on this proxy net, so the car seekers drive like car_saval; share kept at 0.1 to keep the car population essentially the Saval one (M1/car).

Car-following and lateral values kept at Saval Table 11 (targets M1/moto 0.2957 s, M4 overshoot). Share lowered from 0.9 to 0.75 only so that the space-seeking riders can reach the observed wrong-lane share of motorcycles (M8/moto 0.249).

Share raised from 0.1 to 0.25, matching the observed motorcycle wrong-lane share M8/moto = 0.249 and giving enough riders for the sidewalk target M10a (0.56 veh/cycle) to be reachable; motion params identical to moto_saval so only the seeking rule differs.
Unchanged: single archetype of the moto_violator distribution; no feedback yet on M7a (5.59 waiters) or M7b/M7c, so jmTimegapMinor stays at the SUMO default 1.0 s.

traci_rules.rationale: Unchanged Saval Sec 4 value (front-row motorcycle runs red with probability 0.5); target M3/share/moto 0.098 and M3/per_cycle 3.9 are shares over all motorcycles, and without a simulated red-running figure there is no evidence to move p0, so it is left for the next iteration.

Targets M2/early/moto = 0.1302 (and M2/first_delay): p set to the observed early-start share of motorcycles in the last 10 s of red (0.13), t_before_green 10 s = upper end of the 4-10 s lead-time target window; v_max stays 2.0 m/s. Before this the rule was off, so early-start share was 0 against 0.13.

Targets F2/wrong_lane (observed 0.19-0.23 at q 0-40 m), M8/moto 0.249 and F2/sidewalk/M10a (0.05 at q 20-40 m, 0.56 veh/cycle): q lowered to 20 m because the observed choice queue is about 15 m (M10b 15.34 m, M9c 15.71 m); p_wrong_lane 0.5 and p_sidewalk 0.2 are conditional on a seeker being triggered (p_wrong_lane is redistributed on this net); p_right_lane 0 because that option does not exist here; green check off and v_creep, merge_zone_m kept at base.

reasoning: Prompt has no simulation feedback for this first iteration, so I kept all Saval car-following and lateral values and the swarm_red_running rule at base. I changed only behaviours that were switched off but have observed targets: early_start p = 0.13 from M2/early/moto 0.1302 with t_before_green 10 s from the 4-10 s lead-time window, and queue_space_seeking with moto_seeker share 0.25 (M8/moto 0.249), q = 20 m (choice queue about 15 m in M10b/M9c), p_wrong_lane 0.5 and p_sidewalk 0.2 (sum <= 1, p_right_lane 0 because it does not exist on this net). The seeking probabilities are my assumption, not measured, and are conditional on the seeker being triggered; the next iteration should adjust them from the F2 and M10a feedback.
